title: Qataluna atashana
body:
qataluka atashana
zabahuka ibrana
ya hussaina ya hussaina
ya hussaina ya hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
hai fiza mein teri khushboo
thame kaise mere aansu
hai shikasta mera pehlu
kahan jaaun batlana
qataluka atashana...
<<DIVIDER>>
rahun kaise mai watan mein
mera suraj hai gehen mein
mere taare hai rasan mein
phira kaisa ye zamana
qataluka atashana...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri dunya mera mehwar
meri dhaaras mera dilbar
mera yusuf mera akbar
hua barchi ka nishana
qataluka atashana...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali asghar ki shahadat
hai anokhi teri ghurbat
liye haathon pe wo mayyat
kabhi aana kabhi jaana
qataluka atashana...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay wo kaise tere qaatil
jo na samjhe teri manzil
ke mohamed ka hai tu dil
ye na socha ye na jaana
qataluka atashana...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin lut'ti hui chadar
kahin chinte huwe gohar
kahin jalta hua bistar
bada mushkil hai bhulana
qataluka atashana...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri ghairat mera saaya
meri ghurbat mera nauha
meri zainab meri dukhiya
suye zindan hai rawana
qataluka atashana...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi roye yeh biyaban
kabhi tadpe ye teri maa
tere gham mein hai pareshan
tere baba tere nana
qataluka atashana...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere aamir tere nayyar
tere gham mein rahe muztar
inhe har pal mere dilbar
ghame dunya se bachana
qataluka atashana...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
